systems.name: 3.1 Basic Enemy AI
systems.notes: Simple patrol/chase enemies typical of PS1 platformers. No complex behaviour trees. Use state machines.
tasks: Line‑of‑sight chase when player is near
Defeat by freezing then charging (shatter mechanic)

systems.name: 3.2 Static Hazards
systems.notes: Spikes, lava pits, crushing blocks. Use simple collision volumes.
tasks: Crush traps (triggered by proximity or timer)

systems.name: 3.3 Boss Encounters
systems.notes: One boss per world. Pattern‑based, arena fights. Health bar UI. Defeat unlocks new ability or level.
tasks: Boss state machine (idle, attack1, attack2, stunned)
